title: Godzilla: The Reiwa Era
blurb: Toho's two modern Godzillas: a political satire about a government that can't respond to disaster, and an Oscar-winning post-war drama.

groups.title: Godzilla Minus One
groups.note: A separate reboot set just after the Second World War.

note: The two films don't connect, so either can be watched first. Minus One is set earlier but was made later. Godzilla Minus Zero, a sequel to Minus One, is due in November 2026. The American MonsterVerse films have their own page.
